group.label: StyleSmuggler Protection (Ceymox)
group.comment: Virtual patch for the "StyleSmuggler" GraphQL template-injection RCE advisory (sansec.io/research/stylesmuggler). Keep enabled until Adobe's official security patch is applied.

field.label: Enable Protection
field.comment: Master switch for both protection layers below.

field.label: Reject GraphQL Requests Containing Template Directive Syntax
field.comment: Blocks any GraphQL query or variable containing Magento directive syntax ({{block ...}}, {{template ...}}, {{layout ...}}, etc.) with an HTTP 400 response, before it reaches a resolver.

field.label: Sanitize Transactional Email Template Variables
field.comment: Strips template directive syntax out of every dynamic value passed into an outgoing transactional email (order, invoice, payment failed reminder, etc.) before rendering.
